messages:
Rae: thinking out loud - propose a 'noise-aware gradual fallback' option in rollouts. basically smooths sudden spikes by combining short-term spike detectors with a persistence/hysteresis window. keeps rollback noise down. any red flags?
Omar: sounds useful. do you mean smoothing the routed_pct over time or gating triggers with a persistence window?
Rae: both. compute an instantaneous score from signals (err_rate, p95_latency, model_confidence_drop) then apply a causal smoother and a min-duration hysteresis before adjusting routed_pct.
Lina: audit and replay needs are key. we should record the raw signal snapshot + smoothing state + random seed for any probabilistic decisions so we can deterministically replay behavior. even if we sample rows.
Omar: billing/quotas: ensure attribution records orig_route + final_route + tokens for each request in billing export. otherwise customers will see mismatched invoices.
Rae: agreed. sketch of compact audit row (one-line CSV) we want always:
`ts, rollout_id, decision_type, routed_pct, mode, reason_codes, signal_vec, replay_seed`
Lina: sampling: default compact rows 0.1% and full-trace 0.005% with anomaly-triggered boosts. for very-high-qps customers default rates should be smaller; config per-customer.
Omar: UX: rollout card shows live routed_pct, a tiny sparkline for smoothed score, and a small "why" pill you can click to open sampled audit rows (NL blurb optional). also a big red Freeze button that sets routed_pct=0 and logs operator id.
Rae: NL blurb idea for legal: generated only for sampled rows, e.g. "Auto-routed 8% to fallback due to err_rate=0.12 (high) + low model_confidence, persisted 30s". serverless generation, cached.
Lina: guardrails: add hard_escalate rule: if success_rate < 50% for >30s -> full fallback and page oncall. add cooldown after manual override to suppress churn.
Omar: API snippet for RFC (compact):
```yaml
rollout_id: r_noise_01
mode: noise_aware_gradual
smoothing: { half_life: 15s, hysteresis: 30s }
signals: [ err_rate, p95_latency, model_confidence_drop ]
actions: { probabilistic: true, max_pct: 0.25 }
guards: { hard_escalate: { window: 30s, threshold: 0.5 } }
sampling: { compact_rate: 0.001, full_rate: 0.00005, anomaly_boost: 20 }
telemetry: { audit_retention_days: 90 }
```
Rae: also want an endpoint to replay a sampled window given replay_seed + ts so SREs can reproduce decisions locally.
Lina: Ops asks: cost-preview widget before enabling (median + p95 monthly delta) and a per-customer override API to pin pct.
ops-bot: created ticket PLAT-2222 to add replay endpoint + billing attribution fields.
deploy-bot: will post a weekly digest to #eng-platform when noise-aware_gradual is enabled for tenants. digest includes top reason_codes + cost delta estimate. :robot_face:
Omar: next step Rae - please add this config prototype to a short RFC and include the audit CSV schema. I'll pair on the replay endpoint.
Rae: will do, tagging Lina & Omar. thanks all. :thumbsup:
